text_block_list.text:
The day of the spring Tenno Sho has
arrived, and
Super Creek is getting
wound up by Tamamo
Cross.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Тамамо Кросс even threatens to whomp
me so
badly that I'll never recover.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Determined to protect me, Супер Крик
takes on
the race against Тамамо Кросс
with her heart
ablaze.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
